contract_accepts_packed_float_input.meaning: the smart contract accepts user-supplied packedFloat input for Float128 calculations
contract_accepts_packed_float_input.checkpoint: before the attacker submits the malformed packedFloat

input_passes_sanity_check.meaning: the user-supplied packedFloat is treated as good input because it is greater than the contract's packedFloat threshold
input_passes_sanity_check.checkpoint: before the attacker submits the malformed packedFloat

input_mantissa_digits.meaning: number of digits in the L_MANTISSA of the user-supplied packedFloat (report states 72)

calculation_result_matches_encoded_value.meaning: the Float128 library calculation result is consistent with the value encoded by the input packedFloat rather than a vastly different result from wrong exponent adjustment
calculation_result_matches_encoded_value.checkpoint: after the library decodes and calculates on the malformed packedFloat

assumptions: The attacker is permissionless; the report does not state an authorization requirement for submitting packedFloat input.
The packedFloat threshold and comparison direction of the sanity check are not numerically specified; only the qualitative 'greater than a certain packedFloat threshold' is encoded.
The malformed input is described as a possible attack vector, not an observed transaction.

unresolved.description: The report does not quantify the 'vastly different' calculation result or its magnitude, so the effect is represented only by the qualitative consistency Boolean.
The sanity-check threshold value and exact comparison direction are not numerically specified.

limitations: The impact is formalized as a qualitative consistency relation; the magnitude of the 'vastly different' result is not quantified in the report.
The sanity check is encoded as a Boolean because the report gives no numeric threshold.
The 72-digit mantissa is encoded as a digit count, not converted to bits.
